fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn using STRPluginMessagingAPI, with mandatory pre-UI consent, native multi-master scene controls, translation-only free-scene animated-root synchronization, proxy-only ghost-thread cleanup, idempotent shared speed control, Skyrim-Souls-safe message boxes, and OCum state snapshots.
